background_flatten — 3D surface_fit op

• Data kinds: image2d → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.background_flatten(image, degree=2) (to call the implementation directly, import match3d; match3d.background_flatten(image, degree=2); from the registry, ops3d.get("background_flatten"))

Usage

Fit and subtract a low-order surface (uneven illumination) from an image = shading correction. → flattened.

Fits fit_poly_surface(degree) (default 2nd order) to an (H,W) image with x = column, y = row, and returns image − fit as float64. The output has a mean of almost 0 and contains negative values (for display or thresholding, subtract the min or add a constant). If the foreground is large, the fit is pulled by the foreground too and it gets shaved off (it is safer to fit fit_poly_surface on points excluding the foreground → subtract with eval_poly_surface). Greyscale 2-D only (3-D fails). NaN makes lstsq fail.

Uses: preprocessing before thresholding, illumination correction of ring images unwrapped with polar_unwrap.
